FA Cup first-round draw LIVE: Leicester land trip to Oxford City, Wigan draw Boreham Wood and Sheffield Wednesday handed Oldham tie

By Desmond Kane
Updated 20/10/2026 at 02:14 EDT
TNT Sports on Google
React to this story
1

Live stream and updates as the first-round draw for the 2026-27 Emirates FA Cup takes place this evening, with League One and League Two clubs entering the hat. The 32 non-league sides to have battled through qualifying will be joined by 48 clubs across the third and fourth tier, including former winners Leicester City, Wigan Athletic, Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield Town.

Leicester City and Wigan Athletic, both Emirates FA Cup winners in the past 15 years, will be in the hat for this evening's first-round draw.
They will be joined by four teams reaching the first round proper for the first time in their histories: seventh-tier trio Sholing, Plymouth Parkway and Berkhamsted, alongside eighth-tier AFC Rushden & Diamonds, founded in 2011 following the liquidation of Rushden & Diamonds. Meanwhile, ninth-tier Tadley Calleva are the lowest-ranked team in the hat after securing a replay against National League side Aldershot, with that tie set to be played on Tuesday.
HBO Max is the streaming home of TNT Sports - watch the draw below from 18:30 UK time.

17:25 - Welcome to the FA Cup draw

We know we are reaching the heart of any football season when the FA Cup arrives on the scene.
And tonight the road to Wembley gets underway for some of England's most historic clubs, and a few who are aiming to enjoy the romance of the world's greatest knockout competition.
We get up and running with the draw at 18:30 with the drama of the occasion almost as fascinating as the football itself.

How to watch and stream FA Cup first round draw

It will be available to watch on TNT Sports 1, HBO Max, and on the TNT Sports YouTube channel.
The show will start at 18:30 UK time and the draw will be made from approximately 18:35 UK time.
The first round will be played across the weekend of Saturday, November 7.
